WITH orders_in_range AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.gender
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25'
    AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44'
),
gender_counts AS (
  SELECT gender, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM orders_in_range
  GROUP BY gender
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_order_count
  FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT 
  gc.gender,
  gc.order_count,
  gc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count as above_average
FROM gender_counts gc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE gc.order_count > ac.avg_order_count
ORDER BY gc.gender
